title: Cyngas
extract:
Cyngas is an Archgun Auto Burst-fire rifle, with very high accuracy, status chance, and reload speed.

Characteristics
This weapon deals an almost even amount of  Slash,  Puncture and  Impact damage.
Advantages over other Archgun (Atmosphere)   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Good ammo efficiency, generating relatively small cooldown for the Archgun Deployer for every second fired.
Short reload delay of 0.25 seconds in Archwing.
Fastest reload speed of all Archguns in Atmospheric mode.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
High total damage (240)
Very high reload speed (1.20 s)
Above average ammo max (480)
High status chance (30.00%)
High damage per shot (892.8)
High crit multiplier (2.20x)
Disadvantages over other Archgun (Atmosphere)   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Low crit chance (20.00%)
Below average burst DPS (1984.99)
Below average sustained DPS (1860)
Low magazine size (30)
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Acquisition
The Cyngas's blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Its parts can be purchased from various Syndicates. All parts, except for the blueprint, are tradeable.

Trivia
Cyngas appears to be derived from Cygnus, a constellation visible in the Northern Hemisphere that resembles a swan. The "fins" near the Archgun's upper handle resemble the wings of the constellation in question. The word "cygnus" is itself the Latin word for "swan".
The Cyngas is the first Archwing Auto Burst-fire weapon, and the first Auto Burst trigger weapon in the game overall.
Despite having an Auto Burst trigger in Archwing mode, in Atmosphere mode the weapon switches to a regular Burst-fire trigger.
Shares an aesthetic with the  Agkuza Archwing sword.
The Cyngas is the only archwing weapon that has a part that costs 25.000 Syndicate Standing, all other parts are the regular amount 20.000.
